'''Far-ji''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|Boss]] of the [[Screaming Talons/Legends|Screaming Talons]] gang during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the conflict, Far-ji had a feud with other gangs.<ref name="EV" />
